pages.title: Crafting Texture
pages.text: $(l)assets/patchouli_plus/textures/gui/crafting_improved.png$()$(br)is a texture that replaces the default visual appearance of the recipes in the Patchouli entries with that of Patchouli Plus. You can use it by placing it in the $(l)crafting_texture$() section of your book's $(l)book.json$() file.
